set.body: The frozen corrected-GLS confirmation dated 2026-10-08 retained 2048 independent datasets per cell on each platform. Five corrected cells and all six known-phi controls passed. ar2-high-censored-voxelwise failed AR recovery RMSE (.1062507 > .10), joint null-F 90% exact interval ([.068119,.088063] outside [.02,.08]), and interval-coverage 90% exact interval ([.916066,.935555] outside [.92,.98]); zero fit refusals and JVM/JS agreement <1e-14. Evidence: docs/verification/corrected-gls-qualification-20261008/confirmation/ and docs/plans/corrected-gls-statistical-qualification.md. Diagnose by separating AR order, pooling, nuisance load and censoring effects. Compare estimated-noise covariance uncertainty and whitening restart approximation without attributing causation from this confounded cell. Declare any new diagnostic protocol and fresh confirmation seeds before outcomes; preserve the original adverse receipt and margins. Propose a scientific remedy only after localization; qualify any changed estimator/inference on JVM and Scala.js. Do not claim broad corrected-GLS inference admission, substitute nominal df, or reuse this spent confirmation as a fresh validation campaign.
set.title: Censored voxelwise AR(2): diagnose recovery, F rejection and interval coverage
